title: PI Lunch & Learn: Documenting Soft Tissue Cases
summary: A working lunch on the records that actually move a soft tissue case, with a provider and an attorney taking the same file from intake to demand.
description: Soft tissue claims live or die on documentation, and most of the gaps happen in the first three weeks. This session puts a treating provider and a plaintiff's attorney at the same table to walk one anonymised file end to end.

Expect specifics: what the initial exam note needs to say, how gaps in treatment get characterised, and the language adjusters look for when they decide what a case is worth. Bring a question about a file you're working.
Lunch is covered. The panel runs 35 minutes and the room stays open until 2:00 for conversation.
